name: Al-Babtain Power and Telecommunication Co.
summary: Al-Babtain Power and Telecommunication Co., established in 1955 and based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, specializes in delivering comprehensive infrastructure solutions for the power and telecommunications sectors, both domestically and across international markets. Its extensive range of products for power applications includes diverse outdoor lighting solutions such as functional, decorative, flag, mid-hinged, and traffic poles, along with high masts and advanced HID and LED lighting for streets, floods, and obstruction marking. The company also fabricates crucial components for electrical utilities, including transmission and distribution towers and various utility poles. In the telecommunications domain, Al-Babtain provides broadcasting and guyed masts, a variety of self-supporting towers (triangular and square designs), standard and camouflage monopoles, rapid deployment vehicles, and flexible rooftop mounting options. Furthermore, for renewable energy projects, it supplies steel support structures for concentrated solar power (CSP), fixed photovoltaic (PV) structures, solar tracker components, and solar carports. Complementing its manufacturing capabilities, the company offers specialized services, encompassing the installation, maintenance, and repair of wind energy networks, as well as the production of galvanized poles and towers.
